content_hash_groups.interpretation: Cache hash strings only; duplicate labels can reflect different import settings or historical decisions. No full-image MD4 census.

timestamps.interpretation: Windows branch returns FILETIME/10000; converted from 1601-01-01 UTC milliseconds

field_anomalies.interpretation: Threshold counts are diagnostics, not pass/fail labels; texture kinds and fallback states are absent. Non-Assets prefixes are valid Unity Packages paths, recorded separately from unsafe paths.

md4_sample.method: random.Random(seed), block keys sorted, sample(sorted(all paths in block),100), first16 existing paths; certutil -hashfile PATH MD4
md4_sample.scope: 64 stratified existing-image samples only; remaining images not content-hashed

engine_cpp.evidence_kind: current local source; generation-time build identity unverified

verification.path_test: existence and .meta presence only; no image decoding

artifact_search.other_original_png_hit: one UI asset under Assets/UI; not an ASTC_Cache debug reference
artifact_search.scope: Named-file discovery under these roots; no search inside binary Unity Library artifacts

document_verification.md4_resample: same 64 stratified paths, 64 matched again; no wider hash coverage
